overall_strategy_summary: BNY is executing a platform-centric transformation under CEO Robin Vince. The firm has reorganized around a platforms operating model (50%+ workforce, full integration by 2026), delivering 500bps operating leverage improvement. Key strategic priorities: platform transformation, AI integration (Eliza AI platform, AI Hub), digital assets (first G-SIB custody, tokenized deposits, GS DAP MMF tokenization), and outsourcing/vendor consolidation positioning. Archer acquisition ($1.2B, 2024) bolstered capabilities. Data Vault cloud platform empowers client analytics. Record sales in H1 2025 with $1T+ new AUC/A wins.
